examples.text: The Alaska Railroad’s Denali Star train runs between Anchorage and Fairbanks, taking 12 hours to cover the 350-mile trip. The train runs once daily in either direction during the summer months; at the half-way point—south of the Denali Park station—the two trains meet and stop to transfer some of the staff.
